overall_notes: The paper focuses on NLG evaluation through text generation for classification datasets using GPT-3. It uses both automatic metrics (label accuracy, diversity, similarity) and human evaluation (out-of-scope filtering). The LLM-as-judge aspect is verified through the use of GPT-3 few-shot classification as an evaluator for label accuracy. The extraction was generally accurate but contained many duplicates and inconsistent naming conventions.
